profile.role_note: A healer and all-round Crit buffer. She fits any team.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Pull her whenever she is on banner. She is the game's best healer and Crit buffer, and she fits almost any team. The safest support investment in the game.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Stellar Symphony (or Variation) + 5-piece Rejuvenating Glow in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Fallacy of No Return in the main slot. Use a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, and HP% 1-costs. Reach 250% Energy Regen to unlock her full Crit buffs.

ranked_weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. It has a huge Energy Regen substat, an HP boost, and Concerto Energy on Liberation. It also gives the team ATK when she heals. Best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Variation
ranked_weapons.note: The best 4-star alternative. It gives lots of Energy Regen and restores Concerto Energy. Still excellent at S1.

ranked_weapons.name: Rectifier#25
ranked_weapons.note: Decent Energy Regen option, but no Concerto Energy.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: Its ATK% substat boosts her healing. It also has a small Energy Regen passive. Free last resort: the 3-star Rectifier of Voyager.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Boosts her healing. Her Outro grants the team 15% ATK for 30s. Moonlit Clouds usually goes on the other support instead.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Extra Energy Regen, plus a 22.5% ATK buff for the next Resonator. Use it if nobody else is holding it.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus is the standard pick. Crit DMG gets the most from her guaranteed-Crit Intro hit (Discernment).
Energy Regen until she reaches 250% total. Spectro DMG after that.
HP% on both; her kit scales with HP.

teams.name: Premium: Sigrika + Qiuyuan + Shorekeeper

members.name: Sigrika
members.note: Echo Skill hypercarry; runes and enhanced Heavy Attacks scale off Echo Skill DMG.

members.name: Qiuyuan
members.note: Echo Skill DMG amplifier; his Outro grants Sigrika a massive Echo Skill DMG boost.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Crit buffs, healing, and All-Type DMG amplification through Stellarealm.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens. She builds Resonance and Concerto Energy, then deploys Stellarealm. She Outros into Qiuyuan. Qiuyuan runs his Intro combo, Echo Skill, and Liberation. He holds his Heavy Attack string and casts his Resonance Skill, then Outros into Sigrika. Sigrika casts her Echo Skill and builds runes with Basic Attacks. She spends them on enhanced Heavy Attacks and her Liberation. Then she swaps back, so Shorekeeper can detonate Stellarealm.

teams.name: Alternative: Jinhsi + Zhezhi + Shorekeeper

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: The burst carry; Zhezhi's coordinated attacks feed her Incandescence stacks.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Coordinated attacks and Resonance Skill DMG amplification via Outro.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Heals and hands out broad Crit and damage buffs; detonates Stellarealm with her enhanced Intro.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens. She builds Resonance Energy and deploys Stellarealm. Zhezhi builds Forte and her Liberation, then Outros into Jinhsi's full burst combo. Shorekeeper detonates Stellarealm at the end of the rotation.

teams.name: Alternative: Augusta + Iuno + Shorekeeper

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Heavy-attack hypercarry that pauses time with her Liberation to maximize every buff.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Heavy Attack buffer and healer; builds Wan Light stacks for Augusta.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm buffs plus healing while barely needing field time.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm. Iuno runs her Lunar Cycle to build Wan Light stacks. Then Augusta takes a long on-field window: Prowess-enhanced Heavy Attacks, her skill, her Liberation, and the Forte plunge.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: Still the game's best healer. Her Crit buffs fit every team.

sources.record: Shorekeeper best teams (Sigrika/Qiuyuan hypercarry, Sun and Moon, Jinhsi/Zhezhi)

sequences.verdict: S0 is the complete premium support. S2 is the only dupe worth real money. Everything after that is whale comfort.

pull_path.why: Full Stellarealm buffs, healing, and Crit package at S0.
Outer Stellarealm grants the team +40% ATK — her biggest single upgrade.
+42% Intro multiplier and +500% Crit DMG on cast — personal burst for Shorekeeper mains.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Get Stellar Symphony before any dupe. Energy Regen is her most important stat.
